artifacts.summary: Ten phases, 13.5h, seven dependency waves. Enabling attribute/simp-set work up front; the bulk of effort is call-site rewrites.

notes: All three orchestrator decisions applied and restated in the plan. Acceptance gate rewritten to the charted scope: (A) >=80% reduction within the eleven named declarations, baseline 14 -> <=2; (B) absolute per-file before/after table, Soundness.lean 67 -> <=50, CoValidity.lean 1 -> 0, with Truth.lean's expected RISE (19 -> ~25) reported rather than suppressed. Three scope deviations flagged in a dedicated plan table: a NEW module Automation/TruthNormAttr.lean as the register_simp_attr host (NormalizationAttr.lean left untouched, so its 'must not acquire any other content' instruction is honoured as written rather than amended -- this diverges from the research report's own section-3.7 recommendation and the plan says so), Syntax/Formula.lean (swap_norm tags on the eleven swap_temporal_* lemmas), and the validOn_iff_total move across Validity/FwdRec/FwdRecBridge. Phase 3 is the sole globally disruptive phase, isolated, atomic-batch, with the researcher's 48-line bare-simp audit list as its blast radius and the confluence/termination probes as its safety argument. New planning-time finding: SoundnessLemmas.CoValidity is manifested known-unreachable, so lake build never compiles it -- check-module-invariants.sh is mandatory on Phases 4 and 10. The new module must NOT be manifested as unreachable: it gains importers in Phase 2 and C6 fails on an entry naming a reachable module.
